question: Can an outer-fit-only ensemble and a symmetric M3S member remove the scale penalty at an affordable local cost?
decision: Select a concrete reduced-cost point algorithm for fresh-seed simulation calibration; no confirmatory decision.
scope: Scratch only, one CPU worker, NPROC=1 before JAX. No remote operations.
design: 64 concepts, three fixed strata 27/22/15 (provisional proportional allocation), D=4, layer=41, 5 outer folds; four graded and five mixture members; 8 cold starts, existing recovery; no inner selection.
comparison: Old four-member mixture ensemble versus five-member ensemble including M3S, same graded fits and outer folds.
cap: 7200 process CPU seconds total, including compilation and all three datasets. Stop before another fit when less than 240 CPU seconds remains; retain incomplete dataset as incomplete.
estimate_before_run: Existing legacy point pipeline 900 CPU seconds with inner fits (PREREGISTRATION_T1_model.md:950); outer-only nine members expected 300-1200 CPU seconds per dataset, total 15-60 CPU minutes plus M3S compilation. Not a measured cluster rate.
